description: Cross-language hash fixture. Single source of truth for SPEC §3.9 / T12. Regenerated by tests/generate_hash_fixtures.py.

fixtures.name: empty_source
fixtures.description: All-whitespace source collapses to empty string.

fixtures.name: simple_tikz
fixtures.description: Plain TikZ block, no preamble, no attrs.

fixtures.name: tikz_with_comments_NOT_stripped
fixtures.description: Python's normalize() does NOT strip TikZ '%' comments — the adapter is responsible for any per-language preprocessing, but the Phase 2 dispatcher passes block.source raw. The TS port must match this behavior; comments must alter the hash.

fixtures.name: crlf_line_endings
fixtures.description: CRLF must canonicalize to LF before hashing.
fixtures.source:
line one
line two
line three

fixtures.name: lone_cr_line_endings
fixtures.description: Lone CR (legacy Mac) must canonicalize to LF.
fixtures.source: line oneline twoline three

fixtures.name: multi_blank_line_collapse
fixtures.description: Multiple blank-line runs collapse to a single blank line.

fixtures.name: leading_trailing_blanks_stripped
fixtures.description: Leading + trailing blank lines are dropped.

fixtures.name: per_line_whitespace_strip
fixtures.description: Python's normalize() uses ln.strip() per line — both leading AND trailing whitespace per line. PLAN.md §Phase 8 pseudocode said trimEnd() (trailing only), which would diverge. TS port MUST use full strip(); this fixture catches that bug.

fixtures.name: language_distinguishes_hash
fixtures.description: Same source under a different language tag must hash differently (SPEC §3.7 T10).

fixtures.name: preamble_change_invalidates_cache
fixtures.description: Different preambleHash → different cache key, even with identical source (SPEC §3.7 T10 anti-poisoning).

fixtures.name: attrs_empty_object
fixtures.description: attrs={} → both Python and JS produce the same JSON ('{}'). Baseline before the spaces-divergence fixture.

fixtures.name: attrs_single_key_PYTHON_JSON_SPACES
fixtures.description: Python json.dumps emits '{"k": "v"}' WITH a space after the colon; JS JSON.stringify emits '{"k":"v"}' WITHOUT. The TS port MUST replicate Python's spacing in its own pythonJsonDumps helper or the hash will diverge silently when attrs become non-empty in Phase 9+.

fixtures.name: attrs_multi_key_sorted
fixtures.description: Python sort_keys=True sorts top-level keys alphabetically; JS JSON.stringify(obj, Object.keys(obj).sort()) produces the same ordering BUT without the inter-key spaces. TS port must sort AND match Python's spacing.
